response.rationale: The proposed national split is materially overstated. “Papan tulis putih” is an established Indonesian term, and “papan putih” is used in Malaysian educational/commercial contexts, but the shared borrowing “whiteboard” is also used in both varieties. The answers denote the same ordinary object, so different-common-word is not a robust relation. The English cue and sense are correct. The false-friend contrast is empty and provides no useful disambiguation.
